_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pelican-eggs/generic (MIT).
name: Bun
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Runs a JavaScript or TypeScript app, such as a Discord bot, on Bun from your files or a Git repository. Dependencies are installed when package.json or the lockfile changes.
startup: if [ -d .git ] && [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ]; then git pull --ff-only || echo "git pull failed: starting what is here"; fi; if [ -n "{{BUN_PACKAGES}}" ]; then bun add {{BUN_PACKAGES}}; fi; if [ -f package.json ]; then h=$(cat package.json bun.lock bun.lockb 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then if [ -f bun.lock ] || [ -f bun.lockb ]; then bun install --frozen-lockfile; else bun install; fi && cat package.json bun.lock bun.lockb 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1 > node_modules/.raptor-installed; fi; fi; exec bun run "{{MAIN_FILE}}" {{BUN_ARGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Bun: clones the app's Git repository, if one is set. Files already in
# the server's folder are never deleted or overwritten.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

clone() {
    if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
        echo "No Git repository set: upload your app's files, then start the server."
        return 0
    fi
    local url="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    case "$url" in *.git) ;; *) url="$url.git" ;; esac
    if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
        url="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${url#https://}"
    fi
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo "The repository is already here: pulling the latest changes."
        git pull --ff-only
    elif [ -n "$(ls -A)" ]; then
        echo "The folder already has files and isn't a Git repository, so nothing was cloned."
    else
        GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git clone --depth 1 ${GIT_BRANCH:+--branch "$GIT_BRANCH"} "$url" . || {
            echo "The repository couldn't be cloned: check its address, and the username and access token for a private one."
            exit 1
        }
    fi
}

clone
echo "Installed."

variables.name: Main file
variables.description: The file that starts your app, such as index.js or src/bot.ts.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: An https link to the app's repository, cloned when the server is installed. Leave it empty to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: The branch to clone. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Your username on the Git host, for a private repository.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: An access token that can read the private repository.

variables.name: Pull updates at start
variables.description: Pull the repository's latest changes every time the server starts.

variables.name: Extra packages
variables.description: Packages to add as well, separated by spaces.
